caption: The drawing features a stylized wrought iron gate with a prominent cross at the top center. The gate consists of a semi-circular arch filled with ornate, symmetrical scrollwork patterns, predominantly consisting of curled and spiral motifs. Beneath the arch, vertical iron bars with pointed tips extend downward. The cross at the top has square geometric elements at its base, connecting it to the gate’s curved structure. Near the upper right section of the composition, there is a small, circular form with a spiral design resembling an eye or a stylized moon. The color palette is limited to shades of black, grey, and hints of blue, rendered in smooth ink and watercolor washes. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the details of the gate and the cross within a lightly outlined rectangular frame. Faint architectural features can be seen in the lower background, depicted with very light washes, and the image as a whole is enclosed within a simple border close to the edge of the paper.
title: Iron Cross - Gate Ornament
